name: sampler-gears
title: Gear sampler: the gears
description: The sampler's gears laid out to print: a row a module (0.8, 1, 1.5, 2), a pair at each backlash, marked on top with one, two or three dots (0.1, 0.2, 0.3 mm); and two more module 1 gears at 0.2 for the rack and the ring. Each goes on the plate's pins where its label says.

width.rule: Face width, twenty layers, as the plate's pins expect

bore.rule: The plate's 3 mm pin and a line's clearance, so a gear turns on it

dot.rule: A marking dot three lines across

dot_height.rule: Three layers proud of the face

extra_backlash.rule: The rack's and ring's pinions: their backlash

dot_pitch.rule: Dots five lines apart along their ring: clear of each other, easy to count
